parameters.name: Reference
parameters.description: A reference to the STOMP Connection used by this Controller when communicating via the STOMP MTP.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description: The STOMP destination where the Controller will be listening to incoming USP messages.

parameters.name: USPServiceRef
parameters.description: A reference to the USP Service associated with this Agent when communicating via the STOMP MTP.

object.description: If the USP Endpoint uses the STOMP Message Transfer Protocol (MTP), then this object contains STOMP Client specific configuration parameters related to how this Controller communicates with the STOMP Server.
